eight_state_fibre.proof: All other operations are T functions of the initial words and shift result. If two amounts>=32, both shift results are zero; the outputs have equal low16, contradicting eight distinct target low3 values.
eight_state_fibre.scope: Exactly one data-dependent SHR, its amount reads an initial word, and every other operation is MAD/arithmetic/bitwise/literal-SHL. A new first-operation amount and multiple downward shifts remain open.

no_right_shift.proof: A T op does not split a low16 state class. A left shift splits it at most twice: one common count<16, or zero for larger counts. At most2 left shifts give at most4 classes. Three shifts with no T use the odd/high ancestor pair.

mixed_direction_partition.TRL/TLR: T first: on odd/high target outputs every left/right shift on the value chain has count0. The T ancestor has equal low2 on the recorded pair, contradicting different target bit1.
mixed_direction_partition.LRT: If first left amount is prepared-root constant, normalize L to MAD and use right-core. Otherwise its initial-word amount makes it0 on the rectangle; the second R is literal or has count0, covered by rectangle tests.
mixed_direction_partition.RLT: Prepared-root second left amounts normalize to MAD. Initial-word amounts make L=0 on the rectangle. If second count=first_q, the existing conditional systems use only shift>=32 gives0 and shift0 gives identity, valid for L too.
mixed_direction_partition.LTR: Prepared-root first L normalizes to MAD. An initial-word first amount makes L=0 on all high samples; the middle MAD/bitop high-output tests apply to q=0. Other final value ancestors use the odd/high pair.
mixed_direction_partition.RTL: For a final left shift, an odd target requires count0. Initial-word counts are positive at the recorded odd/high point. Root-constant counts reduce to0 or fail. Count=middle T with identical data is always even; other T-count cases have an initial/shift ancestor and use the odd/high pair. Count=first_q has an odd-target nonzero-count witness for all269 nonzero fixed first-shift cases; zero cases carry no high-to-low information. Initial-word first amounts make first_q=0 on the pair.

all_three_shift_directions: odd/high ancestor pair, all counts on value chain forced0
scope: At most3 straight-line uint32 MAD/XOR/AND/OR/SHL/SHR operations on nine stated live words, arbitrary root-prepared constants and arbitrary data-dependent shift operands. ADD/SUB/MUL normalize to MAD. No DIV/REM/CDIV/comparison/vbroadcast/FLOW/memory/cross-lane operations or larger windows; no global kernel bound.
